interpretation: This gate validates cube integrity, spin integration, geometric partitioning, and same-grid density redistribution. Proxy flags require later Multiwfn or Hirshfeld/Bader cross-checks before chemical interpretation.

pairs.interpretation: The two neutral-doublet states have the same total electron count. Their density difference describes redistribution, not addition of an electron.
